vb_textbox.text: Gnomes are quite specific and you will continue to see the same gnomes throughout. (e.g. you will see the same specific gnomes with the same colour and head shape.) Analyse gnome performance over time: They go through phases of good and bad performance, and each phase (whether good or bad) usually lasts around 5-7 turns before reversing. So when they're doing well, it's a good strategy to keep selecting them until they don't score well. If the basket colour changes or the environment changes that may also hint at a potential change. The highest score a gnome can achieve is 9 and the lowest is 0. You will notice that their scores start slowly dropping below 5. When that happens, start testing other gnomes because they are likely to have improved from their previous low performance. At any one time in the experiment there are generally two gnomes that have high performance that can score between 5-9 points. So try to remember which two gnomes you currently prefer, and it makes it easier to quickly select them when they appear.
